== Notes ==
* Each of the targets struck will be in roughly a straight line compared to each other. This sometimes causes the third foe affected to be farther than ''nearby'' from the initial target (although it will still be ''near'' the second one); this also results in some closer foes avoiding damage altogether.
{{anomaly|Invoke Lightning's animation shows strikes on ''all possible'' targets, not just the three that are actually hit.}}
